name: CSN 6682 液压问题 襟翼问题 积冰/防冰

cards.audioText: your call sign is CSN 6682, you are at stand K38 with Information B, your destination is Guangzhou, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 6682，你位于 K38 停机位，已收到 B 情报，目的地为广州，向武汉放行申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 6682, stand K38, Information B, destination Guangzhou, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 6682，K38 停机位，B 情报，目的地广州，申请 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: you have the transmitter checked and carry out radio check with Wuhan Delivery on the frequency 118.3.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已检查发射机，并在频率 118.3 上与武汉放行进行无线电检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 6682, radio check on one onr 8.3, how do you read?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 6682，在 one onr 8.3 上进行无线电检查，听我信号如何？

cards.audioText: acknowledge the transmission and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 确认收到并申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: roger request ATC clearance to Guangzhou, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，申请前往广州的 ATC 放行许可，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1,200 meters, cruising level 8,400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,200 米，巡航高度 8,400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, and you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A tree and A to holding point Runway 36R, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 6682, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 6682，Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 350 degrees, 5 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，Runway 36R，许可起飞，地面风向 350 度，风速 5 节。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 6682, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 6682，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2,100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，武汉进近，雷达识别，爬升至 3900 米，加速爬升直至通过 2,100 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，加速爬升直至通过 2100 米，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, you find that the flaps are jammed at takeoff position, inform Wuhan Approach this situation, and ask to fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你发现襟翼卡在起飞位置，告知武汉进近该情况，并请求直飞 WHA 排故。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 6682, our flaps are jammed at takeoff position, request fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 6682，我们的襟翼卡在起飞位置，请求直飞 WHA 排故。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, roger, turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，收到，右转直飞 WHA，爬升至并保持 3000 米，按公布程序在 WHA 等待。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 WHA，爬升至并保持 3000 米，按公布程序在 WHA 等待，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: During hold, you notice that 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid rapidly, make an urgency call to Wuhan Approach and request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：等待中，你注意到 1 套液压系统正在快速漏液，向武汉进近发布紧急情况呼叫，并请求下降返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN 6682, 1 of the hydraulic system is leaking fuel rapidly, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CSN 6682，1 套液压系统正在快速漏燃油，请求下降并返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, roger PAN, turn right heading 240, descend to 2,400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，收到 PAN，右转航向 240，下降至 2,400 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 240, descend to 2,400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，下降至 2,400 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: now you have intercepted the localizer Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已截获 Runway 36R 航向道，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 6682, established on the localizer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 6682，已建立在 Runway 36R 航向道上。
